blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — DragonFi Securities Inc. has secured regulatory sandbox approval to offer Philippine investors access to select global stocks and exchange-traded funds (ETFs). Tycoon Edgar Sia II’s DoubleDragon Corp. announced on Tuesday that it had gained admission to the Securities and Exchange Commission’s Strategic Sandbox, or Stratbox, in accordance with Memorandum Circular No. 9, Series of 2024. READ: SEC tests waters with crypto, Binance-linked services DragonFi said it has become the first licensed Philippine broker-dealer approved under the program to provide access to preapproved global equities and ETFs through over-the-counter depositary receipts (OTC DRs).
